description.from: BotSpy source and readiness are owned by a separate active track. Coordinate with that owner before adopting LeftBlock; do not duplicate their source changes, tracker ownership, or hook work. Verify the existing installed integration, policy, interpreter and receipt gate, then agree the safe upgrade and synthetic clean/sensitive/error evidence against the reviewed package. This LeftBlock-board row records the dependency and handoff only. No BotSpy installation or readiness result is claimed here; its own board remains with its owner.
description.to: The coordinated local LeftBlock adoption handoff is complete. An initial state-drift check safely skipped installation; a refreshed plan then installed and verified the integration while preserving project state. Clean synthetic content passed and a sensitive fixture was blocked without advancing the temporary test HEAD. BotSpy source and overall readiness remain owned by the separate readiness track; this LeftBlock-board row closes only the local adoption handoff. No BotSpy tracker ownership or source work was taken over. Public package release is a separate pending task.
